description:
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC) is seeking proposals from sources capable of completing CONSTRUCTION PROJECT: Industrial Wastewater Treatment Plant Upgrades at the Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center  

 This procurement is a total small business set-aside 

 The Estimate Price Range: $10,000,000 and $20,000,000 

 Please read the attached Solicitation in it's entirety and all other Attachments. Follow the instructions outlined in Sections L & M for submitting a responsive proposal. Please include the solicitation number 6973GH-27-R-00005 in the subject line of all email correspondence as indicated in Section L of the SIR 

  ***ATTENTION: REVIEW SECTION L.1 OF THE SIR FOR THE MANDATORY SITE VISIT INSTRUCTIONS***  

 Prospective offerors are REQUIRED to attend a MANDATORY pre-proposal conference/site visit to be held at 10:00 a.m. Central Time, Monday, November 2, 2026 at the Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center. The conference will be held for the purpose of site investigation and permit general discussions regarding this Screening Information Request. 
 
IMPORTANT NOTICE: Proposals from offerors who did not attend the pre-proposal conference WILL NOT be considered for award 
 
Offerors are allowed to send a maximum of three (3) individuals to represent their proposal (to include proposal teams, if applicable). Please advise the Contracting Officer, Andre Casiano, at andre.casiano@faa.gov in writing of your intent to attend by 12:00 p.m. Central Time, Friday, October 30th, 2026. Telephone requests will NOT count as notification of attendance. The Contracting Officer will send out information regarding visitor/vehicle passes and initial meetup location, no later than 2:00 p.m. Central Time, Friday, October 30th, 2026 to ONLY those that have provided the required response information. Your request must include the following information: 

 (1) Name of company represented 
(2) Name and title of representative 
(3) Phone number of representative 
(4) Email address of representative 
  

  -------UPDATE October 21, 2026-------  
Amendment 0001 is hereby posted, Please see attached “Amend 0001 6973GH-27-R-00005" 

 This amendment incorporates the below clauses and provision to the SIR 
a) AMS Clause 3.6.4-3 BUY AMERICAN ACT - CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS (JAN 2024) 
 
b) AMS Clause 3.6.4-4 BUY AMERICAN ACT AND FAA BUY AMERICAN PREFERENCE – CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS UNDER UNITED STATES-MEXICO-CANADA AGREEMENT (JAN 2024) 
 
c) AMS Clause 3.6.4-8 BUY AMERICAN ACT AND FAA BUY AMERICAN PREFERENCE - USMCA IMPLEMENTATION ACT - BALANCE OF PAYMENTS PROGRAM (JAN 2024) 
 
d) AMS Provision 3.6.4-18 CERTIFICATION REGARDING STEEL AND MANUFACTURED GOODS (APR 2022) 
 
 -------UPDATE Nov 2, 2026-------  
The document "Site Visit Attendance Log IWTP 27-R-00005.pdf" is hereby posted. This document reflects attendance for the IWTP site visit which occured on November 2, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. 

 There will be a forthcoming amendment to change the due date to submit questions to November 9, 2026, 4:00 p.m., The anticipated release of this amendment is November 3, 2026 NLT 5:00 p.m. 
 
 -------UPDATE Nov 4, 2026-------  
Amendment 0002 is hereby posted, Please see attached “Amend 0002 6973GH-27-R-00005" which adjusted the due date for questions to Monday, November 9, 2026 
 
 -------UPDATE Nov 16, 2026-------  
Amendment 0003 is hereby posted, Please see attached “Amend 0003 6973GH-27-R-00005" which extends the proposal due date to November 30, 2026, 4:00 p.m. Central Time and correct the proposal submission email address at Section L.2 paragraph (f) to "andre.casiano@faa.gov" 

 The FAA is currently in the process of formulating answers to the questions submitted by interested offerors. Once answers have been formulated a Q&A Log will posted
